title: Helicopters escorting UFOs into mountains

tellings.quote: The fact that you have helicopters escorting some of these UFOs and UAPs into the mountains,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are reports of helicopters escorting UFOs, or UAPs (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the newer official term), into mountains. He tells it as a sign that someone on the ground knows about these objects and may be guiding them to hidden sites inside the mountains.
